provider_chain.fallback_return: Returns children immediately with safe capability defaults before async init completes.
Returns children while adapter access loads; unauthenticated state resolves to empty arrays and unknown access.

actual_order: AuthProvider -> AuthGuard -> CapabilityStateProvider -> AdapterAccessProvider -> ModuleAccessProvider -> ConsoleShell
capability_init_trace: Initial render starts from safe fallback state: empty registry, empty access snapshot, fallback live-gate reports, and isFallbackMode=true.
Mount effect sets mountedRef=true and checks initStartedRef.
If initStartedRef is false, it is set true and loadCapabilityState() is called exactly once for automatic init.
loadCapabilityState() reads auth from latestAuthRef instead of capturing changing auth state in the init dependency chain.
If auth is not authenticated, applyFallbackState() resolves fallback state and clears local loading.
If auth is authenticated, read-only frontend APIs are loaded in parallel and normalized into a single capability access snapshot.
If every API result is unavailable, isFallbackMode remains true; partial success renders degraded state, not a blocked render.
catch and finally paths preserve fallback state and clear isLocalLoading when mounted.
